card.name: Year digit in textbook citations
card.fires_on: Most strongly the last digit of a year like 201x in a reference citation (publisher; year:chap). Weaker hits on small words such as 'or', 'for' or 'net' in medical or other list text.

modes.label: Citation year digit
modes.description: The final digit of a 201x year in a textbook reference, just before ':chap'.
modes.example: Schaffer JV, et al, eds.Dermatology. 3rd ed. Philadelphia, Pa: Mosby Elsevier; 201<<2>>:chap 13. Kevin B

modes.label: Linking word in label text
modes.description: A small word like 'or' or 'for' inside a warning or use statement, such as pregnant or breastfeeding.
modes.example: are pregnant<< or>> plan to become pregnant. Tranylc

modes.label: Other scattered words
modes.description: Occasional words in non-medical text, such as a percent sign or a word before a noun.
modes.example: The racial makeup of the city was 94.76<<%>> White, 0.36%

card.plain: It fires mostly on the last digit of a year in a textbook reference, and weakly on small linking words in drug-label text.
